definition_fixture.content_shape: Wwise 2022.1 SoundBanksInfo XML with Platform/BasePlatform=Mac, SchemaVersion=16, SoundBankVersion=145, one User/SFX SoundBank, ShortName matching the unique WAAPI_TASK6_SANDBANK_* input name, and Path matching '<ShortName>.bnk'.
definition_fixture.source_reference_hash_policy: record SHA-256 of the generated definition content and source project *.wproj/*.wwu hash before/after the destructive run
definition_fixture.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<SoundBanksInfo Platform="Mac" BasePlatform="Mac" SchemaVersion="16" SoundBankVersion="145">
  <SoundBanks>
    <SoundBank Type="User" Language="SFX">
      <ShortName>{bank_name}</ShortName>
      <Path>{bank_name}.bnk</Path>
    </SoundBank>
  </SoundBanks>
</SoundBanksInfo>

metadata.promotion_policy: Do not promote ak.wwise.core.soundbank.processDefinitionFiles from call success, an empty mapping, or ak.wwise.file_error. Promotion requires WAAPI-visible SoundBank readback tied to the definition ShortName and cleanup/source immutability proof.

assertions: definition file path is under the copied sandbox root and never under tests/_org/2022.1
processDefinitionFiles result is not accepted as proof when it is an empty mapping, contains only call success, or contains only ak.wwise.file_error
object.get readback finds a SoundBank whose name equals the definition ShortName and path ends with that ShortName
cleanup deletes the created SoundBank and object.get by id returns an empty array
source .wproj mtime, source mutation-bearing project-file hash (*.wproj, *.wwu), and source generated-output snapshot are unchanged

cleanup_expectations: definition file remains only under sandbox output until sandbox cleanup
no WAAPI_TASK6_SANDBANK_ SoundBank remains after successful test
expected_mutations: process a sandbox-only SoundBank definition file if Wwise accepts the version-correct fixture

blockers.reason: Wwise 2022.1 returned no usable SoundBank mapping/readback for the version-correct SoundBanksInfo definition, so the exact result/error must be recorded without promotion.
ak.wwise.file_error is a parser/file blocker and is not behavioral evidence for processDefinitionFiles.

cleanup: delete created SoundBank if object readback identified one
object.get by created SoundBank id returns an empty array
delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies
